criterion: The site presents the public apartment catalogue alongside a sales console.
evaluation_rule: Yes if both the public apartment catalogue and the sales console are present. No if either surface is absent.

criterion: Releasing an apartment moves the apartment onto the public index in place.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a released apartment appears on the public index in place after release. No if the console navigates away or the apartment stays absent.

criterion: A reduced-motion preference collapses every reveal on the index to a still state.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a reduced-motion preference removes the reveals on the index. No if the reveals play regardless.

criterion: The callback form prefills the apartment when opened from a detail page.
evaluation_rule: Yes if the callback form carries the chosen apartment when opened from an apartment detail page. No if the form opens with no apartment attached.

criterion: The live count on the apartment index equals the number of apartments shown.
evaluation_rule: Yes if the count numeral on the index matches the number of apartment cards rendered. No if the count and the cards disagree.

criterion: The apartment index narrows through a quiet row of filter controls.
evaluation_rule: Yes if the index carries filter controls for typology, bedroom count and sort. No if no filter controls are present.

criterion: Opening an apartment on the index reaches its floor plans.
evaluation_rule: Yes if opening an apartment from the index leads to a detail page showing its floor plans. No if the floor plans are unreachable.

criterion: Each floor plan image on the apartment detail page carries descriptive alternative text.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a floor plan image carries alternative text describing the plan. No if a floor plan image carries empty or missing alternative text.

criterion: Photography on the apartment index is uncovered rather than faded on arrival.
evaluation_rule: Yes if a photograph is revealed by an uncovering wipe as it arrives. No if photographs simply fade in or appear at once.

criterion: The apartment index leads with one primary action set apart from the filter controls.
evaluation_rule: Yes if one action reads as the primary one on the index. No if the filter controls and the primary action carry equal visual weight.

criterion: Reveals on the apartment index ease at one shared speed rather than snapping.
evaluation_rule: Yes if reveals on the index ease consistently. No if reveals snap or overshoot.

criterion: Body text on the apartment index holds WCAG AA contrast against the warm neutral ground.
evaluation_rule: Yes if body text on the index meets WCAG AA contrast against the ground. No if body text sits below the ratio.

criterion: The apartment grid reflows to a single readable column at a narrow phone width.
evaluation_rule: Yes if the apartment grid stacks to one column at a phone width. No if content overflows sideways.
